messages:
Priya: Heads up — we're seeing a steady uptick in requests with missing `x-api-version` that our router is coercing to v1. version_coercion_rate metric jumped ~4x yesterday. Probably edge proxies stripping headers.
Alex: Hmm. Any tenant patterns?
Priya: Mostly a handful of mobile SDK customers behind a 3rd-party CDN, and some EU gateways. Sample log: `INFO router: header_missing x-api-version tenant=acct_42 inferred_from=query param=version=1`.
Sam: Oof. Coercing silently is sketchy for both perf and billing. If proxies strip the header but clients send `?version=2` we should respect that where safe.
Jordan: Respecting query param is reasonable, but that changes routing determinism. We need telemetry and a clear console affordance before flipping behavior.
Maya: Also billing disputes if we start routing by query param without telling customers. We should add an attribute so billed-tokens show provenance (explicit vs inferred).
Priya: Proposal: 1) Emit a boolean tag `version_inferred` on requests and a reason enum ("header_missing","proxy_strip","legacy_client"). 2) Add per-tenant timeseries `version_coercion_rate` and `version_inferred_ratio`. 3) Add console badge and an opt-in toggle "Prefer query param for routing" in tenant settings + hover copy.
Alex: Nice. For the router change, I sketched minimal logic:
```
// router pseudocode
if (hasHeader("x-api-version")) use header;
else if (hasQueryParam("version") && featureFlag(tenant,"prefer_query_version")) use query;
else fallbackToDefault();
log("version_inferred", reason);
```
Sam: That looks safe — default off. rollout plan: dark deploy -> 1% shadow traffic where we evaluate divergence, then 5% cohort of tenants opt-in, monitor latencies + token counts + billing diffs.
Jordan: Dashboard queries we need: `sum(token_count) by inferred_vs_explicit, tenant`, `count(requests where version_inferred) by tenant`, and an alert when inferred_rate > 0.05 for a tenant.
Maya: Add a CS-facing exportable CSV to help dispute investigations: rows with tenant, ts, inferred_reason, model_routed, tokens, request_id.
Priya: Agreed. UX copy for console: "If enabled, Redwood will read version from the `version` query param when the header is not present. This helps clients whose proxies strip headers. We strongly recommend enabling only after validating on a small subset."
Alex: Ops note: ensure stable audit log entries and a rollout flag in the console so we can flip back per-tenant. Also add a per-tenant telemetry page that surfaces spikes in inferred routing.
Sam: Can we add a lightweight regression test that simulates header-stripped requests and asserts model selection parity for opt-in tenants?
Jordan: Yes — integration test in `router_integration_test` with a small seq len and a mocked CDN that strips headers. Add tag in traces: `inference.path=queried` vs `inference.path=header`.
Maya: Legal/finance: pinged about potential billing credits workflow. We should include metadata in invoices if a significant portion was inferred during a billing period.
Priya: Rollout timeline suggestion: today instrument logs + metrics, by EOD add dashboard panels, early next week dark deploy, mid-week 1% shadow cohort, then console toggle dev for QA.
Alex: I'll open the PR for the router change and metrics. Priya — can you own dashboard panels?
Priya: Yup, I'll put together panels and link queries in the PR.
deploy-bot: deploy started for feature/route-version-inference -> env=staging, id=deploy-6821 :rocket:
Sam: Thanks, all. Let's keep the default behavior unchanged until we validate. :thumbsup:
Maya: Tagging @CS to prep for possible tenant outreach templates.
Priya: Will post follow-ups in #product-notes once dashboards live.
__notes: thread discusses header stripping by edge proxies, telemetry and console UX for version inference, rollout plan, billing concerns. Short Slack-style messages; includes code snippet and dashboard query examples.
